paite: Huan TOUPAN Sinai tangah Mosi a houpiha,
english: Yahweh said to Moses in Mount Sinai,

paite: Israel suante houpih inla, a kiang uah, Kon gam piak ding na vatun hun chiang un, TOUPA mina gam a khawl ding ahi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to Yahweh.

paite: Na lou ah kum guk sung thil na ching dianga, na grep huan kum guk sung na sat nou dinga, a gahte na la ding:
english: Six years you shall sow your field, and six years you shall prune your vineyard, and gather in its fruits;

paite: A kum sagih kumin bel gam khawl kinkenna, TOUPA mina khawlna ahi dinaga: na lou-a buh leh bal na chin ding ahi kei, na grep huan na sat nou ding ahi sam kei.
english: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to Yahweh. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.

paite: Na buh pou na la ding ahi kei, na kep louh grep na lou ding ahi kei: gam khawl kinkenna kum ahi ding hi.
english: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and the grapes of your undressed vine you shall not gather. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

paite: Gam khawl kuma-te na nek tawm ding uh ahi dia; nang, na sikha leh na sikhanu ading, na kilohmi ading, na kianga teng gamding mi ading;
english: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.

paite: Na bawng hon ading, na gama ganta ading, huaia gah tengteng nek tawm ding ahi ding hi.
english: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

paite: Huan, khawl kum kum sagih bel na sim dinga, kum sagin mun sagih ahi dinga; khawl kum kum sagih sung bel kum sawmli leh kum kua ahi dinga.
english: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.

paite: Huai khit kha sagihna ni sawm niin pengkul ngaihtak na vial mut sak dinga; kilemna niin na gam tengteng uah pengkul na vial mut sak dinga uh ahi.
english: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

paite: Huan, kum sawmngana bel na kipahpih ding ua, gamsung teng teng ah, huaia om tengteng kiangah noplenna thu na phuang ding uh: nou ding in Jubili ahi dinga; mi chihin nou-a chiat na nei nawn ding uh; mi chih amah in sungkuan ah a om nawn ding.
english: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.

paite: Huai kum sawmngana pen nou dingin Jubili ahi dinga; bangmah na ching kei ding ua, a pou leng na la kei ding ua, grep kep louh gah leng na loh louh ding uh ahi.
english: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

paite: Jubili ahi ngala; na kipahpih ding uh ahi; huan, na lou ua thil gahte na ne ding uhi.
english: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

paite: Hiah Jubili kumin mi chihin amaha mah na nei nawn chiat ding uh.
english: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.

paite: Na insakinkhang kianga banghiam na khota, na insakinkhang kianga banghiam na leiin leng an kikhem ding uh hi lou ahi:
english: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.

paite: Jubili khit a kum zah bang jelin na insakinkhang thil na lei dinga, buhlehbal tun kum tam dan dungjuiin na kiangah a juak ding ahi.
english: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.

paite: A kum tam dan dungjui jelin aman na khangsak dinga, huan, a kum tawm dan dungjuiin aman na kiamsak dinga; buhlehbal tun kum tam dungjuiin na kianga juak ahi hi.
english: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.

paite: Na kikhem ding uh ahi kei, na Pathian laudan na siam ding u hi: Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi ngala.
english: You shall not wrong one another; but you shall fear your God: for I am Yahweh your God.

paite: Huaijiakin ka thusehte na jui in ka vaihawmte na pomin laudan na siam ding ahi; huchiin tua gamah lungmuangin na teng ding hi.
english: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.

paite: Gamin a gah a suah dinga, niang leh taiin na ne un na ta ding ua, lungmuang takin na vateng ding uhi.
english: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

paite: A hih leh, a kum sagih kumin bang ka neta ding ua? Ngai dih, bangmah lah ka ching kei ua, ka thil tungte uh lah ka lasam kei ua, chi na hih uleh,
english: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase”;

paite: A kum guk kumin ka vualjawlna na tunguah ka tungsak dinga, kum thum sung adia gah a suah ding hi.
english: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bring forth fruit for the three years.

paite: Huan, a kum giat kumin na ching ding ua, thil tung na kep uh, a luite na ne ding ua, kum kua kum tan, a hong thak nawn ma tanin na vom uh, a luite na ne ding uhi.
english: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits, the old store; until the ninth year, until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.

paite: Khantawn adia gam pen khot den ding ahi kei, gam lah keia ahi ngala: mikhual, ka kianga teng lel na hi ngal ua.
english: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.

paite: Na gam luah tengteng uh, tat kik thepthup na phal ding uhi.
english: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.

paite: Na unau honggentheiha, a gam khenkhat a juak leh; a tanau naipen a hongkuan dia, a unau gam juaksa a tan ding.
english: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

paite: Huan, min a tat sakmi ding a neih louha, a hong kitoha, a tatna khop a neih leh,
english: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it;

paite: A khot kum sut henla, a khotnapa kiangah a val pe nawn hen; huchiin a gam a luah nawn ding.
english: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.

paite: A maha dia a tatkik nawn theih kei lebel a khotsa pen Jubili kum tanin a leipa khutah om hen; huan, Jubili kumin a pawt nawn dinga, aman a gam a luah nawn ding hi.
english: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee: and in the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.

paite: Huan, kulh nei khuaa in min a juak leh a juak akipan kum khat ngial sungin a tan nawn thei ding; kum khat vingveng sungin tat nawn theihna a nei ding.
english: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

paite: Kum khat sunga a tat theih kei leh kulh nei khuaa in pen khantawnin a suante jel tanin leng a leimi-a ahi bikbek ding ahi, Jubili chiangin leng a pawt tuan kei ding.
english: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.

paite: Kulh neilou khuaa inte bel singtang gam banga seh ahi dinga, tat theih ahi dinga, Jubili chiangin a pawt ding.
english: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be reckoned with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

paite: Himahleh Levi-tepawl khua, a tantuam khua ua inte jaw Levi-tepawlin chiklai peuhin leng a tan thei ding uh.
english: “‘Nevertheless the cities of the Levites, the houses in the cities of their possession, the Levites may redeem at any time.

paite: Huan, Levi-tepawl laka min a tat kei leh juaksa in leh a tantuan khua pen Jubili chiangin a pawt ding: Levi-tepawl khuaa inte Israel suante laka a tantuam uh ahi ngala.
english: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

paite: A khokim khawng ua loute bel juak theih ahi kei ding, a khantawn tantuan uh ahi ngal a.
english: But the field of the suburbs of their cities may not be sold; for it is their perpetual possession.

paite: Huan, na unau a hongentheiha, nang a hongbelh leh nana kep ding ahi; mikhual, na kianga teng banga na na ompih ding ahi.
english: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support him among you; then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.

paite: Amah laka dangka hiam, thil hiam, a pung la ken, Pathian laudan siam jawin: na unau na kianga a teng theihna dingin.
english: Take no interest from him or profit, but fear your God; that your brother may live among you.

paite: A pung delhin na sum na leitawi sak ding ahi kei.
english: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

paite: Kei na TOUPA na Pathian uh, Kanaan gam honpepa leh na Pathian uh hi dinga Aigupta gam akipana honpikhepa ka hi hi.
english: I am Yahweh your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

paite: Huan, na unau a hongentheiha, na kianga a hong puk lut leh sikha banga na zat ding ahikei.
english: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you; you shall not make him to serve as a slave.

paite: Kilohmi bang leh na kianga teng sam bangin na kiangah a om ding ahi: Jubili kum tanin na na a sem ding.
english: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee:

paite: Huai khitin na kianga akipan a pawt dinga, amah leh a tate toh, huan, amau inkuanngei ah a lut nawn ding uh, a pi leh pute in leh lou a luah nawn ding uhi.
english: then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.

paite: Aigupta gam akipana ka pi khiak, ka sikhate ahi ngal ua, sikha khota khot ding ahi kei uh.
english: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

paite: Khel takin a lakah na om ding ahi kei, na Pathian laudan na siam jawk ding ahi.
english: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

paite: Sikhanu leh sikhapa na neih dingte na kim ua nam laka mi, sikhanu leh sikhapa dingin na lei ding uh ahi.
english: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have; of the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

paite: Huan, na lak ua teng gam dang mi leh na gam ua piang a inkote uh laka mite leng na lei thei sam ding uh; huaite na mi na sa uh ahi ding uhi.
english: Moreover of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.

paite: Huan, na nung ua na tate uh gouluah dingin, a mi a sa ua a neih ding un amau dingin na bawl ding uh; huai laka mite na khantawn sikha ding un na nei ding uh: himahleh na unau Israel suante laka khel takin na om ding uh ahi kei.
english: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession; of them may you take your slaves forever: but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.

paite: Gam dang mi hiam, na kianga teng kuahiam honkhophata, a kianga na unaupa a honggentheiha, na kianga gam dang mi hiam, na kianga teng kiang hiama, gam dang mite suan inko laka hiam a puk lut leh.
english: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family;

paite: Khotsa a hih nungin tat nawn theih ding; a unaute laka khatin amah a tan thei ding.
english: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;

paite: A pangakin hiam, a pangak tapain hiam a tan thei ding; a chite laka a tanau naiin hiam a tan thei ding hi; huan, amah leng a hongphat nawn leh a kitanthei ding hi.
english: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.

paite: A puklut na pa toha puklut akipana Jubili kum nawn ding sut khawm uhenla a puklut man a kum omdanin ahi dinga; huan kilehmi dia goih sut bang jela sut sak ahi ding hi.
english: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee: and the price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; according to the time of a hired servant shall he be with him.

paite: Kum tampi a om lai leh a tatna manpen a belh sung hu toh kituak man a piak kik nawn ding ahi.
english: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

paite: Jubili kum tunna ding kum tawm chik kia om phet ahihleh sut khawm uhen; a om kum tamdan dungjuiin a tatna man a piak kik ding ahi.
english: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.

paite: Kum khat bi jela goih kilohmi bangin a bel ding hi: Na mitmuhin khel takin a bawl ding ahi kei.
english: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him: he shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.

paite: Huchibang lama tat a hih kei lehleng, Jubili kumin a pawt dinga, amah leh a tate toh.Israel suante lah ka sikhate ahi ngala ua, Aigupta gam kipan ka pi khiak, ka sikhate ahi uh; Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee, he, and his children with him.

paite: Israel suante lah ka sikhate ahi ngala ua, Aigupta gam kipan ka pi khiak, ka sikhate ahi uh; Kei TOUPA na Pathian uh ka hi.
english: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am Yahweh your God.
